caveats: Covered subsets are small and not random: an item is covered only if its exact text was ever a PAA candidate of some Segment (search_demand rows with volume, claim-by-name shortlist, top-20 cap).
segment_match items already passed these two gates (real_questions tier 1 reads atom_matches the gates fed), so their verdicts are non-reject by construction: coverage there is biased to KEEP.
The 90 trap questions were written by reviewers; a verdict exists only if the same text was a real PAA.
about_here was asked against the Segment's country set and landing against one Segment moment, not the T9 piece scope (multi-day blog subject, tour, place). Different question, different scope.
Gate order: A3 asks landing only about questions the country-scope gate kept, so a landing verdict rarely exists for an about_here drop. 'and' / 'or_both_covered' are therefore biased to KEEP.
a3_question_foreign (also in the A3 scope call, OFF since S246) is not used.
Floor-sweep rows are in-sample (fit and scored on the same items): optimistic.

exact.llm_calls_saved_note: a piece's FAQ filter is one Haiku call for all its questions; a covered question saves tokens, not a call, unless EVERY question of the piece is covered.
